summary_en: Interim dividend raised 1.0 yen to 17.50 yen per share; year-end dividend raised 1.0 yen to 17.50 yen per share, bringing full-year dividend to 35.00 yen from 33.00 yen previously forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast (Upward Revision) and Revision of Interim Dividend (Increase) and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
ALSOK announced on November 10, 2026 a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, increasing both the interim and year-end dividends. The interim dividend per share was raised by 1.0 yen to 17.50 yen, and the year-end dividend per share was raised by 1.0 yen to 17.50 yen, bringing the total annual dividend to 35.00 yen from the previously forecast 33.00 yen. The interim dividend of 17.50 yen compares to 14.60 yen in the prior year.

The company raised its full-year earnings forecast at the same time, citing solid performance in the first half of fiscal 2027, driven by strong results in security services and FM operations. It also incorporated the impact of acquiring Nihon Dry Chemical Co., Ltd. as a consolidated subsidiary. Net income attributable to parent company shareholders was revised upward by 14.8 billion yen to 52.1 billion yen, with earnings per share increased to 107.82 yen from 76.75 yen.

The company stated that profit distribution backed by earnings, combined with maintaining adequate retained earnings, forms its basic policy for returning profits to shareholders.
